summary.plain: The room next to the SM-3 research reactor at the Research Institute of Atomic Reactors in Dimitrovgrad, Russia, where the Neutrino-4 detector was moved on rails 6 to 12 metres from the reactor core.
summary.technical: Laboratory at the SM-3 reactor (former neutron beamline hall) with the Neutrino-4 detector on rails at 6-12 m from the core centre. Marked with a campus-grade point for the RIAR site.
